integrity_notes: The novelty claim excludes the known complete-bipartite fair-domination number, the known K_{n,n} fair-set counts, and the general complement principle. The retained claim is the crown all-set classification, polynomial, minimum-set multiplicity, and total-count identity.
scientific_limitations: The all-n theorem is proved symbolically; exhaustive computation is only a regression check through n=9. Literature searches cannot exclude a poorly indexed equivalent result. A 2010 thesis repository entry mentions fair domination but supplies no verified public-posting day, so no day was inferred from its approval date.
title: Fair-domination polynomial of crown graphs
